title: Hud Warns 'Aad, and Salih Comes to Thamud

paragraphs.text: Hud told his people that he asked them for no payment. His reward would come only from the Lord of the worlds. Then he warned them about their behavior. They built a tall sign on every high place just to amuse themselves. They made palaces and strong fortresses, as if they would live forever. When they attacked others, they attacked like cruel tyrants. So Hud told them again to fear Allah and obey him. He reminded them to fear the One who gave them everything they knew. Allah gave them grazing animals and children, gardens and springs. Hud said he feared for them the punishment of a terrible day.

But the people did not listen. They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise us or not. This is only the custom of the people before us. We will not be punished." So they denied Hud, and Allah destroyed them. In this there is a sign, but most of them did not believe. Your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Then the people of Thamud also denied the messengers. Their brother Salih came to them. He asked, "Will you not fear Allah?" He told them that he was a trustworthy messenger sent to them.

hardWords.m: to do something only for fun
an old way of doing things
